admission.justification: An arbitrary dependency cap can force unrelated judgments onto coarser evidence even when the payload model admits their precise witnesses.

applicability: Dependency capacity derived for coherence and other bounded record builders.
conditions: Fixed dependencies, model-bounded judgments, assessments and validator edges derive the shared capacity.
An over-model payload refuses before artifact writes.
exclusions: Master-scope route review has no own finite model bound and remains subject to the explicitly ruled shared refusal.
Shared evidence is allowed only when it actually supports each judgment.
